data.body:
[P2] Preserve cleanup-fatal priority after a nonfatal setup failure

Post-manager setup in `DurableExecutor.execute()` remains outside its failure-handling catch. If that setup throws a nonfatal exception—for example, `Invocation`'s second `Context.getAwsRequestId()` call—and owned shutdown subsequently throws an `InternalError`, finalization runs only through automatic `close()`. Try-with-resources suppresses the cleanup fatal beneath the nonfatal setup exception, so the caller does not receive the fatal. Move post-manager setup inside the catch that passes the original failure to `finishInvocation`, and extend the setup regression test to cover nonfatal setup followed by fatal cleanup.
